verses.text: their wine is the poison of serpents and the cruel venom of asps.
No one is so fierce that he dares to stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
Behold, the day of the Lord comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger, to make the land a desolation and to destroy its sinners from it.
An evil man seeks only rebellion, and a cruel messenger will be sent against him.

All your lovers have forgotten you; they care nothing for you; for I have dealt you the blow of an enemy, the punishment of a merciless foe, because your guilt is great, because your sins are flagrant.
They lay hold on bow and javelin; they are cruel and have no mercy; the sound of them is like the roaring sea; they ride on horses, set in array as a man for battle, against you, O daughter of Zion!”

They lay hold of bow and spear; they are cruel and have no mercy. The sound of them is like the roaring of the sea; they ride on horses, arrayed as a man for battle against you, O daughter of Babylon!
Whoever is righteous has regard for the life of his beast, but the mercy of the wicked is cruel.
Wrath is cruel, anger is overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?
For the ruthless shall come to nothing and the scoffer cease, and all who watch to do evil shall be cut off,

For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat; for the breath of the ruthless is like a storm against a wall,
Or, ‘ Deliver me from the adversary’s hand ’? Or, ‘ Redeem me from the hand of the ruthless ’?
Therefore strong peoples will glorify you; cities of ruthless nations will fear you.
I will punish the world for its evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; I will put an end to the pomp of the arrogant, and lay low the pompous pride of the ruthless.
therefore, behold, I will bring foreigners upon you, the most ruthless of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your splendor.

But the Lord is with me as a dread warrior; therefore my persecutors will stumble; they will not overcome me. They will be greatly shamed, for they will not succeed. Their eternal dishonor will never be forgotten.
like heat in a dry place. You subdue the noise of the foreigners; as heat by the shade of a cloud, so the song of the ruthless is put down.

Foreigners, the most ruthless of nations, have cut it down and left it. On the mountains and in all the valleys its branches have fallen, and its boughs have been broken in all the ravines of the land, and all the peoples of the earth have gone away from its shadow and left it.
For thus says the Lord: “ Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken, and the prey of the tyrant be rescued, for I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
O God, insolent men have risen up against me; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, and they do not set you before them.
“ This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage that oppressors receive from the Almighty:
I have seen a wicked, ruthless man, spreading himself like a green laurel tree.
But the multitude of your foreign foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the ruthless like passing chaff. And in an instant, suddenly,
I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless.”
